QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is an empty `asm volatile ("" : [x] "+r" (x))`. The compiler must treat the value as unknown, so it cannot prove a condition constant and fold a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier that makes the compiler treat a value as unknown, and it places the layer in library/constant_time_impl.h.
